verdict.rationale: GlitchTip has no evidenced built-in AI root-cause analysis. It does ship a built-in MCP server that lets your own external AI assistants browse issues, inspect stack traces and event data, and run analyses such as N+1 detection, so root-cause help depends on a bring-your-own AI tool rather than the platform's own AI. Missing for 10: native in-platform AI root-cause analysis, evidenced use of breadcrumbs and related commits in analysis, proposed fixes or root-cause output, and independent corroboration of AI-assisted debugging.
